zone.description: Nothing from the network is let in except the doors listed here; everything else is rejected. Outgoing connections are unaffected, and so are the replies to them. SSH (key-only) is the only door open by default; the Webtop's HTTPS port is opened only while network access is switched on in Settings > Remote Access (cosmos-remote), and closed again when it is switched off. dhcpv6-client is not a service anyone connects to: it lets this computer receive the answer to its own IPv6 address request.
